correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact channel: n>=4 over a labeled ternary alphabet, one nonwrapping four-position window rotated by 1, 2 or 3, identity included, duplicate outputs collapsed. Each window contributes <=3, giving 3n-8; the six-periodic prefix 000121 achieves all three increments for every appended window. A nontrivial cyclic rotation changes at least two coordinates, so the new terminal window cannot duplicate an output from any old window overlapping it in at most one position. This proves six-letter locality for every n, not just checked n. Independent complete 3-ary balls for n=4..8 give 72,126,246,474,930 maximum centers; the 21 canonical five-letter states and 41 edges were independently rebuilt from exact balls. Exact left-vector annihilation by Q(A) (order 10), plus the first ten values 126..47850, proves the displayed rational generating function for all n. Connectivity of the listed finite graph and its 01201 self-loop give primitivity and the Perron growth rate. Finite enumerations are graph/identity checks, not an extrapolated infinite proof.
